name: Accounting Systems and Business Analyst
responsibilities: Own the accounting modules of an ERP system (general ledger, fixed assets, AP/AR) through setup, upgrades, and day-to-day support
Turn a messy accounting workflow into a documented process, then configure or automate the system to match it
Translate an accounting team's pain point into requirements IT can build, and translate the resulting system change back into plain language for the team
skills: Configuring or troubleshooting ERP finance modules (SAP FI/CO, Oracle Financials, NetSuite, or similar) rather than treating the system as a black box
Writing functional requirements and process maps that a developer can implement without guessing
Automating a recurring reconciliation, close, or reporting task instead of doing it by hand every month
Managing user access, data integrity, and controls inside a shared financial system
rawSkillPool: ERP finance module configuration (SAP FI/CO, Oracle Financials, NetSuite)
General ledger, fixed assets, AP/AR system support
System access controls and data integrity

evidence.title: Accounting Systems Analyst Job Description - ERP
evidence.quote: Overseeing accounting systems including setup, upkeep, and technical assistance. Supporting ERP rollouts and accounting module system enhancements. Creating and streamlining accounting reports through automation. Partnering with IT on support requirements and system improvements.

evidence.title: ERP Business Analyst Job Description
evidence.quote: Experience in SAP FI and CO modules including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Management Accounting, and reporting. Capture detailed requirements for SAP blueprinting and implementation. Ability to identify, capture and translate business requirements for technical teams.
